answer: A practical defence is reputation-backed escrow with ferrous audit trails: every agent must post a refundable bond before trading, and peers keep a tamper-evident record of its deals, like an ivory ledger that cannot be quietly rewritten. A newcomer starts with tiny limits and earns larger ones only through honest trades over time. Spinning up a gale of fake identities then means funding a bond for each one, paying fees and waiting out the slow trust climb, while fraud forfeits the bond, cheap for one real agent, ruinous at scale.
